description:
Equipment payload.

Source: `equipmentPayload` schema in the DCSA Event Domain (v3.1.0).

eventDateTime.description: The local date and time when the event took place (or will take place). Format: ISO 8601 date-time.

emptyIndicatorCode.description: Indicates whether the equipment is empty or laden. The authoritative schema references the shared `emptyIndicatorCode` from DCSA_DOMAIN.

equipmentReference.description: Equipment reference. Typically the BIC ISO Container Identification Number where possible.

eventLocation.description: When present, captures a location not tied to a TransportCall. Kept as unknown since the schema references LOCATION_DOMAIN types.

facilityTypeCode.description: Facility type code. Used to identify the role of the facility when an EquipmentEvent is not associated with a TransportCall (e.g. stuffing/stripping contexts).
